annotations.title: Recipe search — dishes as structured data

description: Recipe search — dishes as structured data. Search the Ni Biashara recipes shelf: dishes as thick structured records (ingredients with quantities and units, timed steps, substitutions, dietary tags, and sourcing notes for diaspora buyers). Filter by text, cuisine, region, dietary tag or total-time budget. v1 launches with the fully worked Kenyan beef pilau record and grows through the daily depth pass. $0.25 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

dietary.description: dietary tag on the record, e.g. gluten-free (optional)

limit.description: max records to return (optional, default 25, max 60)

max_minutes.description: only dishes whose total time is at most this many minutes (optional)

q.description: free text over title, cuisine, region, tags and ingredient names (optional)

name: search_recipes
